scripts.dev: pnpm run build:packages && concurrently -n packages,web,api -c yellow,blue,green "pnpm run watch:packages" "pnpm --filter web dev" "pnpm --filter api dev"
scripts.dev:web: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter web dev
scripts.dev:api: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter api dev
scripts.build: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter web build && pnpm --filter api build
scripts.clean: rm -rf apps/web/build apps/web/.react-router apps/api/dist packages/*/dist packages/*/.tsbuild
scripts.start: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "pnpm --filter web start" "pnpm --filter api start:prod"
scripts.test: pnpm --filter api test && pnpm --filter auth test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm -r --filter './packages/*' typecheck && pnpm --filter web typecheck && pnpm --filter api typecheck
